There's a Jedi. He helps people. [...] I'll take you to him. For the right price.|Jayco, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} '''Jayco''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[con artist]] who worked on the [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era]] alongside [[Haja Estree]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|We had him. Look at this reward.''"
"''Oh, that's embarrassing.''"
"''It says he's with a girl. He'll have half of the city on him now.''"
"''Let's get to him first.|Jayco and Haja|}} [[File:JaycoHaja-OWKpII.png|thumb|left|300px|Jayco reports the bounty on Kenobi to Estree.]] Around [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|II}} Jayco resided on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], living a life as a [[con artist]] with his partner-in-crime [[Haja Estree]]. Estree posed as a [[Jedi]] who helped those in need in order to make a living, with Jayco helping to be his eyes and ears to direct potential customers to Estree's hideout. At one point, he directed [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been searching for the recently-kidnapped [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], to Estree. After [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] put a bounty on Kenobi, Jayco alerted Estree that they had unknowingly found a real Jedi, and Estree grabbed his [[blaster pistol]] to go and search for Kenobi himself, later encountering him and giving him information to help him escape Daiyu as an attempt to make amends for his petty operation as a con-artist. ==Behind the scenes== Jayco was created for the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', and was portrayed by [[Jecobi Swain]] in ''Part II'' of the series. In the episode Jayco approaches Obi-Wan Kenobi and offers to lead him to "a Jedi" prior to Kenobi having located Princess Leia. The reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'', released on [[November 19]], [[2024]] by [[Dorling Kindersley]], erroneously states that Jayco approached Obi-Wan Kenobi and Leia Organa offering his help.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/obi-wan-kenobi/part-ii-guide|text=Part II Episode Guide | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Jayco |es=Jayco |fr=Jayco |ja=ジェイコ（詐欺師） |ka=ჯეიკო |nl=Jayco |pl=Jayco }} [[Category:Con artists]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
